_comment: Shapes for tests/unit/test_mana_ability_once_each_turn.py. t_once_font is Vivi Ornitier's shape reduced to the claim: a by-hand mana ability with a printed per-turn limit. t_unlimited_font is the same ability without the limit, so the test can tell an enforced limit from an ability that simply cannot be activated twice.
